answer: Radio-neighbour witnessing ties each agent to a physical node: at random moments, nearby mesh devices must hear its signed beacon over short-range radio and co-sign the sighting. N fake heads need N radios in N distinct spots, each bought and powered, so cost grows per head. Like a falcon sighting prey from one vertex of a timber tower, witnesses see a farm's many keys all shouting from one antenna, and the cluster is merged.
